title: Symphony - Odyssey - Mins to Broadway - Pool & Gym
description:
Welcome to Symphony, 4 stylish Midtown units that come together for the ultimate Nashville getaway! Sip morning coffee on one of the private balconies, whip up culinary creations in sleek kitchens, or lounge by the sparkling, resort-style pool. Take a stroll through Centennial Park for picnics, concerts, and scenic photo ops, then hit Broadway for live music, cocktails, and unforgettable nights. Symphony is your ultimate Nashville playground for adventure, relaxation, and nonstop good times!

The space
⭐ Building Accommodations & Amenities:
- Prime Midtown location in the heart of Nashville
- Just a 2-minute stroll to beautiful Centennial Park
- Only a 4-minute drive to the bright lights and live music of Broadway
- 4 Private balconies perfect for morning coffee or evening unwinding
- Year-round resort-style pool (open 8 am – 8 pm, subject to HOA discretion)
- Communal poolside area featuring a cozy fire pit, BBQ grill, and lounge seating for relaxing and socializing
- State-of-the-art fitness center for your daily workouts
- Smart TVs in all the living rooms and primary bedrooms for easy streaming
- In-unit washer & dryer in all units for added convenience during your stay
- Elevator access for smooth, easy movement throughout the building

🛋️ Living Areas:
- (4) Open-floor living areas
- Floor-to-ceiling windows with abundant natural light
- Comfortable sectional sofas
- Smart TVs
- Stylish décor & thoughtful finishes
- (4) Private balconies with outdoor seating

🍽️ Kitchen & Dining:

❗️Notes to Guests & Important Details:
- The pool is open year-round, but may close due to extreme weather. Hours of operation are 8 am - 8 pm.
- While not all 4 units are directly next door to each other, they are all on the 3rd floor, and the building has an elevator to take you to each floor.

- This is an upcoming neighborhood, so there may be construction for surrounding buildings. Depending on your booking dates, guests may experience nearby construction noise.
